title: LRU Cache
hints: You need O(1) lookup (hash map) and O(1) 'move to most recent' plus 'evict least recent' (doubly linked list).
collections.OrderedDict gives you both: move_to_end(key) on access, popitem(last=False) to evict.
Both get and put count as 'use'. Updating an existing key must also move it to most-recently-used.
